extensionName.description: Name of the extension. Also shown under Settings → Home → New tabs.

extensionDescription.message: Open any website in new tabs and keep the address bar free for searching.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the add-on manager.

newTabTitle.description: Title of the new tab page.

hintNoUrl.message: No URL for new tabs has been set yet.
hintNoUrl.description: Shown on the new tab page while no URL is configured.

hintCannotOpen.description: Shown on the new tab page when the URL cannot be opened.

openOptions.description: Button on the new tab page that opens the options.

urlLabel.description: Label of the URL field in the options.

modeEmbed.description: Option: show the website inside the new tab page.

modeEmbedHint.message: The address bar stays empty, so you can search right away.

modeRedirect.description: Option: navigate the new tab to the website.

modeRedirectHint.message: Use this if the site does not work embedded (e.g. you are not signed in).

focusPage.message: Focus the page instead of the address bar

focusPageHint.message: Firefox normally puts the cursor into the address bar of new tabs.

noteSelectInPreferences.message: In the Firefox settings under Home → New tabs, “Custom New Tab URL” must be selected. Only http:// and https:// pages are supported.
noteSelectInPreferences.description: Note at the bottom of the options.

removed.description: Status after saving an empty URL.

errorInvalidUrl.description: Error when the entered URL cannot be parsed.

errorScheme.message: Only http:// and https:// are supported.
errorScheme.description: Error for URLs like about: or file:.

errorPermission.message: Embedding needs permission for this site.
errorPermission.description: Error when the host permission was declined.
